text_block_list.text:
When I visited the cafeteria, Verxina and 
Tosen Jordan were enjoying tea together. 
But then――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo yo yo! Grinding those beans with plenty 
of pep, I see!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa... what the heck!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Golshi-san. Good day to you. This is 
black tea, not coffee, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ grass, huh. My bad, my bad. Indeed, it 
carries the silhouette of a crooked cashew 
nut...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, it is Ceylon tea from Sri 
Lanka.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Insane. ......The incomprehensible 
nonsense has begun.
choice_data_list:
(She's right, I have no clue what they're 
saying...)

text_block_list.text:
Just as Tosen Jordan said, the exchange 
between Gold Ship and Verxina made zero 
sense...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll grab something to drink too. 
Just finished feeding the killer whales, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go with beans! As for the 
size, I'm feeling more stink bug than 
rhinoceros beetle today~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: My, so a smaller coffee is fine for today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah. No clouds, no stars, just a 
completely pitch-black night sky, 
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you do drink black coffee quite often, 
don't you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And then, like, saving a super bulky file 
in .zip format, that kind of vibe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Something compressed―― You mean an 
espresso, correct?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it was on today's 
recommendation list. Wouldn't that be 
quite perfect?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Right on, Sen no Rikyu!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...No, seriously, what are you even 
saying?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. Like, is something wrong with 
me...?
choice_data_list: No, you're fine. I don't get it either...
No, you're fine. I don't get it either...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I KNEW it, right?! Totally, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why does Verxina-chan understand this? How 
do you even do that...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That is... because we are from the same 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Peers of the same generation are special 
to anyone. In most cases, they are the 
ones with whom you compete the most for 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, how one's peers normally 
approach their mindset and conduct――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
First, one must understand and study that. 
To stand on equal footing――no, to surpass 
them.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In short, the present situation is simply 
the result of that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yup! So basically, that's the kind of bond 
me and Verxina got going on!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............ ............Wait, what is 
that pose?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You get what she's doing?

I looked closely at Gold Ship's pose once 
more. This... this must be――!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Half-width alphanumeric!! The answer is: 
"The white rice supporting a katsudon"!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Half correct, is it? That was quite close.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That was CLOSE?! Wait, so Verxina-chan 
actually knew...?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I could see the nuance of something 
supporting another from beneath, so I 
figured it was likely a rice bowl dish.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's insane... No way I could ever 
do that~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Like, how could anyone know?! 
Verxina-chan, what's the answer~~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let me see. I saw the nuance of supporting 
from beneath, so I believe it is likely 
some sort of rice bowl dish.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Half-width alphanumeric!! The answer is: 
"The white rice supporting a katsudon"!

Just as I muttered that in my mind―― I 
noticed a figure swiftly pass by.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, magnificent as always, 
Verxina-san.
